#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

class IO {
public:
    std::istream& in;
    std::ostream& out;
    IO() : in(std::cin), out(std::cout) {}
    void println(const auto& x) { out << x << "\n"; }
    template<typename T>
    T next() {
        T val;
        in >> val;
        return val;
    }
    void close() {} // no action needed for standard streams
};

class D {
public:
    IO io;

    void solve() {
        long long n = io.next<long long>();
        long long m = io.next<long long>();
        if (m < n) std::swap(n, m);

        if (n == 1) {
            io.println(brute1(m));
            return;
        }
        if (n == 2) {
            if (m < 3) io.println(0);
            else if (m == 3) io.println(4);
            else if (m == 7) io.println(12);
            else io.println(2 * m);
            return;
        }
        // general case solution:
        io.println(2 * (n * m / 2)); // if odd number of squares, cannot fill all with no gaps
    }

    long long brute1(long long m) {
        long long ans = 6 * (m / 6);
        long long rem = m % 6;
        if (rem == 5) ans += 4;
        else if (rem == 4) ans += 2;
        return ans;
    }
};

int main() {
    D solver;
    try {
        solver.solve();
    } catch (const std::string& msg) {
        if (msg != "Clean exit") throw;
    }
    return 0;
}
